messages:
michael: incident-bot page — auth-introspect errors spiking in eu-west-1. 502/504s to /introspect from Auth0 edge. Observed ~14:23Z. Paging @oncall-sre and @sre-lead

oncall-sre: on it. pulling logs and checking downstream timeouts. do we have customer-facing impact?

support-rep: getting multiple support tickets: console login failures and API token verifications failing. rough estimate: ~40 tenants, 10 enterprise. customers in eu-west primarily.

sophia: quick snapshot from our edge: a 3x increase in latency to the auth0 edge host and a lot of connection resets. sample error from proxy logs:
```
[2026-03-14T14:23:45Z] proxy eu-west-1 -> auth0.edge.eu 502 Bad Gateway read: connection reset by peer
```

michael: can we route to a fallback region or enable local verification?

oncall-sre: two immediate mitigations: 1) enable JWKS cache fallback to local verification for active sessions (reduce live introspects). 2) route non-console traffic to auth0 eu-central fallback pool. i'll run the change now.

sre-lead: make changes carefully, patching auth-proxy config and not the entire fleet. roll to 10% first.

devops-bot: ran rollout command:
```
# patch proxy configmap to enable jwks_local_fallback
kubectl patch cm auth-proxy-config -n prod --patch '{"data":{"jwks_local_fallback":"true","introspect_timeout":"10s"}}'
# then restart auth-proxy pods in eu-west-1 slowly
kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy -n prod --selector=region=eu-west-1
```

oncall-sre: applied fwk patch to 2 nodes (10% traffic). monitoring. Retries set to 3 with exponential backoff.

incident-bot: change submitted: cm/auth-proxy-config patched by oncall-sre. rollback window 15m.

support-rep: started templated comms to affected customers, flagged top 12 enterprise PS contacts.

ps-team: standing by to assist customers if SSO re-auths required.

michael: results?

oncall-sre: after 6m, error-rate dropped from 18% -> 3% for traffic on patched nodes. global error rate still 6% due to unpatched nodes and origin edge instability.

sophia: running a smoke test against introspect with fallback enabled shows local verification succeeds for cached tokens. but new token introspects still hit Auth0 and can fail.

michael: next steps: coordinate with Auth0 support, request edge pool failover and root cause. add temporary client-side retry guidance for our SDKs.

oncall-sre: opened support case with Auth0 (CASE-2026-0314-042). provided logs and request IDs. asking for edge pool investigation and surge routing.

incident-bot: Pager duty: ESCALATED to SRE oncall -> oncall-sre, alerted oncall-lead.

sre-lead: recommend follow-up actions: 1) keep JWKS local fallback for 24h, 2) apply rolling patch to remaining nodes, 3) add short-term client-side 2s->8s timeout bump, 4) create alerting rule to detect auth-introspect HTTP 5xx > 5% over 5m and auto-open incident channel.

michael: okay. implement rolling patch. can someone update status page?

support-rep: updating status page now: "Partial login failures in eu-west-1 due to third-party auth provider edge instability. Mitigations in progress."

sophia: rolling patches are at 60% now. telemetry shows continued decrease in failures.

oncall-sre: 100% rolled. error rate stabilized at ~1.2%. will keep JWKS fallback for 12h then reevaluate with Auth0 response.

michael: thanks. assign postmortem owners?

sre-lead: i'll own the postmortem. oncall-sre and sophia to co-author. include timeline, mitigation playbook updates, and recommended SDK timeout change.

ps-team: notify top affected customers and offer checkpoint calls.

incident-bot: incident resolved: mitigation in place, monitoring healthy. incident severity lowered to SEV3. follow-up: link to postmortem draft in #eng-postmortems. :white_check_mark:

michael: closing notes: need clearer fallback policy for third-party auth degradations and an automation runbook to flip JWKS fallback without manual patching. add to roadmap.

sre-lead: noted. will add runbook and automation ticket.

support-rep: continuing to triage any remaining customer reports. will escalate if we see regressions. :phone:

michael: thanks all. great quick coordination.
